description_en: Call the DescribeUserLogserviceStatus operation to check whether Log Service is activated or has overdue payments
description_zh: 调用DescribeUserLogserviceStatus查看Logservice服务是否开通或者欠费
name: DescribeUserLogserviceStatus

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Log Service is activated.

true: Log Service is activated.
false: Log Service is not activated
Enabled.description_zh:
是否开通Logservice服务。

true：开通。
false：未开通

InDebt.description_en:
Indicates whether your Log Service has an overdue payment.

true: Your Log Service has an overdue payment.
false: Your Log Service does not have an overdue payment
InDebt.description_zh:
Logservice服务是否欠费。

true：欠费。
false：未欠费

InDebtOverdue.description_en:
Indicates whether the overdue payment for Log Service has timed out.

true: The overdue payment has timed out.
false: The overdue payment has not timed out
InDebtOverdue.description_zh:
Logservice服务是否欠费超时。

true：超时。
false：未超时

OnService.description_en:
Indicates whether Log Service is active.

true: Log Service is active.
false: Log Service is inactive
OnService.description_zh:
Logservice服务是否可用。

true：可用。
false：不可用
